Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this match. We look forward to your company on Saturday for more matches from the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Qualifier. Do join us for all the action. Cheers!

Oman skipper, Zeeshan Maqsood says that he is happy with the performance. Adds that the bowling coach worked a lot on the bowlers and they delivered awesomely. Tells that the run chase didn't go as per their plan but he doesn't want to over-analyze it as it was just their first game. Hopes to qualify for the next round and wants to just keep going on match-by-match.

UAE skipper, Ahmed Raza says that they lacked a bit of intent and needed a partnership in the middle overs. Feels it was their first game and still have five to go to correct their mistakes. States that they fought really well and took the chase deep. Admits that there is always room for improvement. He is confident that his boys will bounce back.

MAN OF THE MATCH, Fayyaz Butt says it is a good way to start the tournament and they played well. Mentions they planned about where they have to bowl and executed it. States he had a chat with the bowling coach about the pitch and he was advised to bowl slower bouncers and that worked for him.

Chasing a paltry target, Oman suffered an early blow but that didn't deter their confidence. Aqib Ilyas and Jatinder Singh formed a partnership to lay the platform and then Aamir Kaleem's fluent knock put Oman on the brink of victory. Aqib stayed unbeaten and steered his side home with 10 balls left to complete a comprehensive win.

A thumping win for Oman to kick-start their campaign! Their bowling was very accurate and that set up this outstanding victory for them. They were right on the money in the field and created relentless pressure by not allowing UAE off the hook. That resulted in the home side struggling for runs and eventually, they managed a score just over 100.
SIX! The skipper finishes it off in style! A short one on the body, he swivels and pulls it a long way back over the backward square leg fence. OMAN WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
Slightly shorter and on off, this is pulled down to wide long on for one.
Another short ball, the batter this time manages to pull it through mid-wicket but just for a run.
One more slower short ball! Maqsood is once again done in by the pace. He mistimes his pull towards mid on. The fielder misfields and a run is taken.
A short one, it is ducked under. Oman are in no hurry to chase this down.
Shorter and on off, this is guided down to third man for one. 100 up for Oman.

Run out chance missed. A slower short one! The batter is way too early in the pull. It goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket. The skipper takes off from the non-striker's end but is sent back. He slips as he tries to turn. The fielder though misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Zahoor begins his new spell with a short delivery wide outside off, Zeeshan stands back and slaps it to sweeper cover for one.
Zahoor Khan is back on. 2-0-16-0, so far.
A dot to end! Shorter and on the body. Ilyas tries to pull but misses.
On the shorter side, it skids through. The batter mistimes it to mid on.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
On off, this is defended nicely.
FOUR! 12 more needed now! Short, wide and put away. It is outside off. Maqsood cuts it past point and it races away to the fence.
Fuller and on off, this is hit to mid off.
Junaid Siddique (2-0-12-1) is back on!
Another couple! 16 more needed in 4 overs. This is on the pads, it is swept behind square on the leg side for two.
On middle, this is pushed to the right of the bowler who makes a good stop. Saves a run. UAE need to save every run possible.
Another couple! The batter comes down the track and stays leg side of the delivery. It is hit wide of long off for two.
Loopy ball on off, Ilyas looks to drive but it goes off the outer half through point for two. 20 more needed.
One more slog sweep which goes on the bounce to the deep square leg fielder. Another single.
On off, this is tapped towards cover and a run is taken.
On the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket. A good over this for UAE.
A single as this is eased down to long on.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They have run through for a single.
Out comes the reverse sweep to a ball outside off. The batter misses.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On off, this is guided to point. UAE need a lot more dot balls if they are to build the pressure.
Off the mark is the skipper. He plays the slog sweep which goes on the bounce to the deep mid-wicket fielder for one.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed towards cover where the fielder misfields and a single is taken.
Zeeshan Maqsood is the new man in. He would love to be there till the end.

OUT! Kaleem holes out! However, he has played a good useful knock here. Also, the 42-run stand here has probably done the job for Oman. Kaleem comes down the track and looks to drag this from outside off over long on. Does not get the distance on it and it goes towards Rameez Shahzad who takes it. 28 more needed.
Gets bat on this one and works it with the angle through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, the batter looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
29 now! This shorter delivery is guided towards backward point for one.
This is angled into the batter, it is worked towards mid-wicket for one. 30 more needed.
Ilyas was aiming for the leg side but the bowler bowls it wide outside off, a full toss though. AI swings but it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Shorter and on off, this is guided to point.
On middle, Ilyas goes down on one knee and hits it over backward square leg. It is not off the middle and hence, slows down as it gets near the ropes. Stopped before it and a couple is taken.
On middle, this is hit to the right of the bowler who dives and stops a single.
Waheed Ahmed is on now!
FOUR! Out comes the slog sweep and it is in the gap in the mid-wicket region. One more boundary for Kaleem. He moves to 26 in 17 balls. 34 more needed.
Singles will do it for Oman! They get one more as this is worked towards square leg.
On the pads, the batter looks to flick but misses. It brushes the pads and rolls towards short fine leg for one. Leg bye signaled.
Outside off, the batter looks to run it down but misses.
Eases this one down to long off for one.
Good running! This is worked with the angle with soft hands through mid-wicket for two.
Ahmed Raza back on! Just the one over for him before this one.
Very full, this is jammed down to long on for one more run.
On middle, Kaleem has worked it towards mid-wicket for one.
Fires it on off, this is defended off the front foot.
Shorter and outside off, too close to cut and hence, Aamir is beaten.
OHHH! A yorker on off, the batter gets his bat down at the very end and jams it out.
The batsman plays the pull shot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! In the gap! A boundary to start the over and one to end it. Short and on the body, Kaleem swivels and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
On the shorter side, the batter waits for it and then guides it down towards third man for one.
Slightly short and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batter. The batsman tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto the leg side for one.
One more full ball outside off, this is carved over cover-point for one.
FOUR! Kaleem is taking all the pressure off here with this knock. Full and outside off, Kaleem lofts it over covers and bags a boundary.

Three runs to end! Out comes the sweep shot. It is hit behind square on the leg side. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, slides and seems to have pushed it back in. The umpires go upstairs to check. It does seem like he has touched the ropes, the umpires though rule it in the fielder's favor.
Slower through the air on off, it is pushed to covers.
A couple! Outside off, it is squeezed past point for two.

EDGY FOUR! The slip fielder was late to react! Need to take such chances. This is pitched on off, it turns away. Kaleem looks to push at it but it goes off the outside edge, closely past the first slip fielder and down to the third man fence.
On middle, this is punched down to long off for one.
This is on off, it is pushed through covers for one.
Rohan Mustafa is back!
Kaleem has driven this one towards cover for a single. Gets off the mark with this single.
Aamir Kaleem walks out to the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oman lose their second wicket and are slightly in trouble. Jatinder Singh pushes this one towards the deep cover region and takes off. He gets to the other end and looks for a quick second which is a risky one. The fielder there, Waheed Ahmed, attacks the ball, picks it up and has a shy at the striker's end. He seems to have missed the stumps but the bails then come off and Jatinder Singh is well short. The square leg umpire might have been unsighted as the keeper was covering his vision but he has raised his finger. Jatinder has to walk back. The replays show that it brushed past the stumps, hits the gloves of the keeper and then deflected onto the stumps. All fair.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Good running this by the Oman batters. Ilyas defends this one off the front foot near the crease. The batters sense a single and are quick to take it.
Length ball just outside off, Ilyas defends this one off the back foot straight towards the bowler.
Length ball on the hips, Jatinder flicks this one towards square leg for one.
Zahoor Khan is into the attack.
Jatinder pushes this one uppishly towards long off. The batters take a run.
Ilyas flicks this flatter one off his pads towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Ilyas drives it superbly towards cover but straight to the man there.
Ilyas pushes this one back to Raza.
Floated on middle and off, pushed towards mid on for one.
On the pads, Ilyas works it towards square leg and takes a single.
Skipper Ahmed Raza is into the attack.
A dot to end a quiet Powerplay for Oman but they will be the happier side at the moment. This is on middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket. Oman are 32 for 1. 77 needed in 84 balls.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, the batter hits it towards mid off.
On middle, this is guided towards point for a quick run. Risky shot that.
Uppish but in the gap! Shorter and on middle, Singh makes room and carves it wide of the diving cover-point fielder. The man at point hares after it and three runs added to the total.
Good stop! This is fired on off, the batter pushes it to the left of the bowler who dives and makes a half stop. Saves a run.
A single to end! On the pads, it is flicked through square leg for one.
On off, Ilyas drops it towards covers and takes one.
On middle, it is once again hit back to the bowler.

FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs! Can't afford to give away free runs, the home side. This is down the leg side, the batter looks to sweep but misses. The keeper has no chance and it goes to the fine leg fence.
Very full and on middle, this is hit back to the bowler.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
On the stumps, the batter goes back and keeps it out.
Change in bowling! Rohan Mustafa to bowl his offies.
A dot to end! This is on off, it is hit back to the bowler.
Almost! This starts outside off and it drifts back in. Ilyas looks to cut but that shot is not on. He gets an inside edge on the leg side for one.
Direct hit but the batter was in! This is on off, it is pushed towards mid off and the batters go for one. The fielder scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batsman is in.
Fires it on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is hit back to the bowler.
On the stumps, this is pushed down to long on for one.

FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Ilyas plays the square cut and the ball races to the point fence for a boundary, past the diving backward point fielder. 11 runs off the over where UAE could have taken a wicket.
Slower length ball outside off, Ilyas tries to cut this ball but fails to do so.
FOUR! Bad ball, down the leg side, Ilyas flicks it fine and gets a boundary as the ball races to the fine leg fence.
On the pads of Jatinder, he flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Jatinder pushes this one straight back off the back foot.

DROPPED! If UAE want to have any chance of winning this match, they need to take these chances. Good length ball on middle and leg, Singh pulls this one towards square leg. The fielder from deep runs in, gets to the ball while diving forward but puts down the catch. The ball rolls in front of him, he gets up and gives it back to the keeper while the batters take two. This could prove to be very costly to UAE.
A dot to end! Gets away with this one though. Shorter and outside off, it is slapped to covers.
Darts it on the pads, the batter looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
FOUR! First boundary of the chase! Too short and outside off, Aqib goes back and cuts it past the cover-point fielder for a boundary.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to the fielder at mid off.
This is shorter and quicker. It skids through. Aqib looks to pull but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Flatter and on middle, it is pushed down to long on for one.
Sultan Ahmed to bowl from the other end.
A single to end a successful first for UAE! This is angled into the pads, it is worked through square leg for one. First run for Oman.
Aqib Ilyas is the next man in.

OUT! Taken! What do you want while defending a low total? Early wickets. UAE have got one here. Siddique has really started off well and he gets the reward. Ali's patience runs out. He comes down the track but JS spots that and bangs it short. It skids through after landing and hurries onto the bat of Ali. He looks to pull but gets a top edge which goes beside the pitch. Raza from covers moves to his right and takes it.
Good length again on off, Ali defends it out. 4 good balls to begin with by the bowler.
That is a beauty! This is angled into the batter at first but then leaves Ali. He looks to push it through the off side but is beaten.
Slightly short, not short enough though to pull. Khawar looks to pull but is hurried onto the shot. It goes towards mid on.
Right on the money to begin with! This is on off, it is kept out.

We are back for the run chase. It looks to be a pretty soft target but the pitch is keeping a bit slow so there could be a few surprises. The UAE players walk out to the middle. They are followed by the Oman openers, Khawar Ali and Jatinder Singh. Junaid Siddique will start the proceedings for the hosts.
